summary: Iteration 54 - Field Job (Cabling/WISP) Enrichment Features Testing Complete. All 3 phases working correctly: Phase 1 (Core tools), Phase 2 (Business tools), Phase 3 (Advanced features). Backend: 33/33 tests passed (100%). Frontend: All enrichment UI elements verified working.

issues: Console warnings about chart width/height being -1 - cosmetic only, existing issue from previous iterations
Console warning: Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent - accessibility improvement opportunity

critical_code_review_comments: Phase 1 Core Tools: Field Notes API works with add/get, Enhanced Checklist supports 5 templates (installation/maintenance/troubleshooting/decommission/site_survey) with toggle and custom items, Site Photos support 5 types (site_survey/before/during/after/completion), Audit trail logs all actions, Progress tracker shows 5 stages

Phase 2 Business Tools: Customer notifications send with templates (en_route/on_site/completed), Quote builder creates line items with subtotal/tax/total calculations, Send quote marks status as 'sent', Approve quote marks status as 'approved', Equipment tracking with type/brand/model/serial/MAC/IP fields, Materials tracking with quantity/unit/cost/total, Site survey info saves GPS/access notes/mounting/weather/safety/power, Push to invoice creates new invoice with materials + labour

Phase 3 Advanced: Job history lookup by address/customer/phone, QR code generation returns PNG image, PDF completion report with branding/job details/checklist/notes/equipment/materials/billing, Dispatch queue returns kanban columns (scheduled/en_route/on_site/in_progress)

Frontend: Field job detail view has 8 tabs (Notes/Checklist/Photos/Equipment/Materials/Quote/History/Audit), 6 header action buttons (Notify/Site Info/Quote/Invoice/PDF/QR), 5-stage progress tracker bar, Signal & Speed sidebar with inputs, Cost Summary shows materials total correctly, Update Status with all stage options
seed_data_creation: Existing field job CW-1002 has test data: 2 notes, 42 checklist items (from installation template), 2 equipment items, 3 materials ($152 total), site info (GPS, access notes, mounting type), 1 quote (approved status). Signal: -65 dBm, Speed: 100/50 Mbps
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 54 complete - Field Job (Cabling/WISP) Enrichment Features verified. Key navigation: Tickets page → Cabling / WISP (2) filter tab → Click CW-1002 or FJ-1001 card. CW-1002 has existing test data. Key data-testids: fj-detail, fj-back, fj-notify-btn, fj-site-btn, fj-quote-btn, fj-invoice-btn, fj-pdf-btn, fj-qr-btn, fj-note-input, fj-add-note-btn, fj-check-input, fj-load-template-btn, fj-photos-tab, fj-equip-tab, fj-mat-tab, fj-add-equip, fj-save-equip, fj-add-mat, fj-save-mat, fj-save-site, fj-save-quote, fj-create-quote-btn, fj-send-notify, fj-new-invoice, fj-signal, fj-speed-down, fj-speed-up. Backend endpoints under /api/field-jobs/* prefix.

1_field_job_detail_view_loads.details: Detail view loads with all enrichment data - Notes(2), Checklist(1/42), Photos(0), Equipment(2), Materials(3), Quote, History(0), Audit tabs. Shows job details, cost summary, signal/speed inputs, status buttons.

2_add_field_note.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/notes creates note with content/note_type/is_internal. GET returns notes sorted by created_at desc.

3_load_enhanced_checklist_template.details: GET /api/field-jobs/enhanced-templates returns 5 templates: installation(26), maintenance(15), troubleshooting(16), decommission(13), site_survey(14). POST with template param loads items.

4_toggle_checklist_items.details: PUT /api/field-jobs/{id}/enhanced-checklist/{item_id} toggles checked state. Shows checked_by_name when checked.

5_add_custom_checklist_item.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/enhanced-checklist/add-item creates custom item with order at end of list.

6_upload_site_photos.details: Photos tab shows 5 upload buttons: Site Survey, Before, During, After, Completion. GET /api/field-jobs/{id}/photos returns uploaded photos.

9_add_materials_with_cost.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/materials adds material with material/quantity/unit/unit_cost. Calculates total automatically.

12_create_edit_service_quote.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/quote creates/updates quote with line_items/notes/tax. Calculates subtotal/total automatically.

13_send_quote_to_customer.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/quote/send marks quote status='sent' and triggers notification.

15_push_field_job_to_invoice.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/to-invoice creates new invoice with materials + labour line items or adds to existing invoice.

16_send_customer_notification.details: POST /api/field-jobs/{id}/notify-customer with notification_type (en_route/on_site/completed). Logs notification history.

17_download_pdf_completion_report.details: GET /api/field-jobs/{id}/pdf returns PDF with branding, job details, site info, signal/speed, equipment, materials, checklist, notes, signature lines.

18_download_qr_code.details: GET /api/field-jobs/{id}/qr-code returns PNG QR code image for job URL.

19_view_job_history.details: GET /api/field-jobs/{id}/job-history returns previous jobs matching service_address, customer_name, or customer_phone.

20_view_audit_trail.details: GET /api/field-jobs/{id}/audit-log returns all action entries with action/details/user_name/created_at.

21_progress_tracker_5_stages.details: UI shows 5-stage progress bar: Scheduled → En Route → On Site → In Progress → Completed. Shows percentage complete.

22_signal_speed_inputs.details: PUT /api/field-jobs/{id} updates signal_strength, speed_test_down, speed_test_up. UI shows Signal & Speed sidebar with inputs.

23_cost_summary_materials_total.details: Cost Summary shows Materials total, Equipment count, and Materials Total. CW-1002 shows Materials: $152.00, Equipment: 2 items.

24_dispatch_queue_columns.details: GET /api/field-jobs/dispatch-queue returns jobs grouped by status columns: scheduled, en_route, on_site, in_progress.

mocked_apis.note: Customer notification email sending uses RESEND_API_KEY if configured (best-effort). Logs notification entry regardless of email send success.
